items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: You know who else I played with? What's that family's name? He's in New York, isn't it?

ctx.x: I think he and Roy Palmer work together. Yeah. Here comes your wife.
Well, yeah, I knew Roy Palmer, but I don't know too much of. Much of Roy Palmer. You know who else I played with? What's that family's name? He's in New York, isn't it?
